scope: Bundled candidate input adapter with simulated gamepads and mock DOM; actual NES CPU joypad latch, pause/reset/load/tab/focus lifecycle. Physical controllers and real mobile browsers require separate acceptance.

results.name: Only the two approved mobile modules and release/documentation text extend the corrected baseline sources
Keyboard aliases and intentional paused keyboard frame stepping remain functional
The actual Frame command preserves held keyboard keys while ordinary Pause releases them
Multitouch combines independent pointers and preserves another finger on release or slide
Opposite directions cancel after keyboard, touch and gamepad are merged
Standard gamepad buttons and left stick feed NES port one after initial neutral sample
Initially held controller cannot take over until all mapped inputs are neutral
Button and axis remapping covers all eight actions; unknown pads are never guessed
Remapping a standard direction removes only that direction’s default axis supplement
Only the selected pad drives port one; deselection and session profiles are explicit
Disconnect drops only gamepad input and does not silently select another held pad
Reusing a gamepad index for another device cannot inherit the prior input or assignment
Disconnect event catches same-model same-index reconnection and requires selection plus neutral
Unavailable or policy-denied Gamepad API leaves keyboard and touch usable
Pause clears every source and paused discovery cannot pre-arm held controller input
Focus loss suppresses all inputs until focus returns and controller is neutral
Hidden documents cannot receive gamepad or touch; returning requires neutral
Nested settings and focus blockers do not reactivate input until every blocker closes
Save, project and palette dialogs suspend inputs for their entire lifetime
Editable focus clears source state and only rearms after field exit plus controller neutral
Tab exit clears touch and keyboard and forces controller neutral on return
Actual reset and ROM replacement clear controls and keep emulator paused
Existing frame loop performs one gamepad sample per frame and never changes port two
NES strobe and serial latch retain captured bits while live input changes
Lifecycle releases expose a generation so held browser pointers cannot resurrect input
Status snapshots cannot mutate adapter state and subscriptions can unsubscribe
